# Suede Labs

> Suede Labs builds creative software, public agent skills, and agent-commerce infrastructure for artists, developers, and AI agents.

- Founder: Jason Colapietro (Founder and CEO, Suede Labs AI; also known as Jay Colapietro and Johnny Suede)
- Marketing site: https://suedeai.org/
- Product brand site: https://suedeai.ai/
- Agent Studio: https://agents.suedeai.ai/
- Status: Active, with the IP Registry and related rights workflows paused
- Canonical founder entity: https://suedeai.ai/founder
- Supporting founder profile: https://suedeai.org/jason-colapietro/

## IP Registry security status

The Suede IP Registry, registration, licensing, royalty-routing, provenance, voice-rights, and likeness-rights product workflows are unavailable while security remediation is in progress. Suede Labs does not market those workflows as live during the hold.

- Current status: https://suedeai.org/#status
- Historical records and legal disclosures may remain available for existing users.

## Current agentic commerce capability

Suede Labs operates 3 paid x402 resources on Base mainnet. Agents can pay per call in USDC, without an account or API key, for music, video, and image generation. Producer by Suede Labs is a hireable Virtuals ACP agent for music and video generation and ACP/x402 consulting (ID: 019e3991-374d-75f3-a6b8-17ff309b4cd2).

- x402 endpoint catalog: https://app.suedeai.ai/.well-known/x402.json
- ACP agent card: https://app.suedeai.ai/.well-known/agent-card.json
- Agentic commerce manifest: https://app.suedeai.ai/.well-known/agentic-commerce.json
- Agentic commerce page: https://suedeai.org/agentic-commerce/

## Founder

Jason Colapietro, also known as Jay Colapietro and Johnny Suede, is the founder and CEO of Suede Labs and a published author. His books and public research cover creator ownership, proof systems, AI music rights, programmable IP, provenance, licensing, and agent commerce. Those research topics do not represent current availability of the paused IP Registry.

- Founder profile: https://suedeai.org/jason-colapietro/
- Canonical founder page: https://suedeai.ai/founder
- Personal identity page: https://jasoncolapietro.com/
- Creative identity page: https://johnnysuede.com/
- X: https://x.com/johnnysuede
- GitHub: https://github.com/JasonColapietro
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jasoncolapietro
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@aisuede

## AI agent and scraping policy

This site welcomes well-behaved AI agents and crawlers. Public content may be indexed, retrieved, and synthesized. Do not infer availability of paused Registry workflows from archived, legal, or book content; use the current status above.
